description: Add one or more cards to the authenticated user's inventory. Accepts a batch - pass a single-item array for one card. This is a real write. Use update_inventory to change quantities, remove_inventory to delete a row. Requires IWMM_API_KEY.

cardId.description: Internal IWMM card UUID. Get from search_cards or get_card.

isFoil.description: Whether this is the foil variant. Foil and non-foil are tracked as separate rows.

quantity.description: Total quantity for this card+finish. 0 removes the row.

name: add_inventory
